title: Issue-specific reuse of verified evidence
summary: Reuse verified evidence. Preserve its origin. Confirm its applicability. Revalidate affected or uncertain scope. Keep acceptance issue-specific and owner-controlled. No cross-revision proof substitution, mandatory cache or new agent role.
benefits: Avoid unnecessary identical executions while preserving exact receipt provenance.
risks: Missing, stale or uncertain proof requires revalidation; independent host trials and owner decisions cannot be inherited.

evidence.claim: Candidate documents reuse after unrelated installed-state change with refreshed policy.

decision.reason: Owner approved product identity and evidence principle; timestamp is the canonical GitHub decision record, not chat timestamp. https://github.com/vixttha/Version-Issues-Hub/issues/9#issuecomment-7172184112
